dish: daily-changing fish dishes from the morning's buying, with a deep sake list (standing bar)
n: Uoya Hidezo (魚屋ひでぞう 立ち呑み店, Ura-Namba)
w: Busy Ura-Namba standing bar run like a fishmonger's counter. Mapple's editors flag the range and the prices of a fish menu that changes with each day's buying, plus plenty of sake to match; Kansai Walker includes it in its Ura-Namba late-night queue-shops round-up.

dish: seasonal-fruit cakes (fruit from trusted growers) and butter-rich baked goods
n: Pâtisserie Liergues (パティスリー リエルグ, Higashi-Hanazono)
w: Neighbourhood patisserie by Higashi-Hanazono Station, picked for Tabelog's Sweets WEST Hyakumeiten 2023 for its seasonal-fruit cakes and baked goods, and one of Time Out Osaka's 27 must-go restaurants of Higashi-Ōsaka/Kawachi.

dish: masu-zushi 'kaisen zeitaku-mori' (crab, uni and roe in a wooden box, ¥599) and the four-kind maguro-mori (¥499)
n: Gyokai Bekkan Nomisuke Kyōbashi (魚介別館のみすけ 京橋)
w: Kyōbashi standing seafood bar, sister to the cheap-and-fresh standing bar Uosuke. Osaka Metro's OsakaMania box-sushi feature and Rurubu both list it for its overflowing box sushi and tuna platter at senbero prices.

dish: yukhoe (raw-beef yukke, served under the licensed raw-meat regime) and Tsuruhashi yakiniku
n: Kainantei Tsuruhashi (海南亭 鶴橋店)
w: Tsuruhashi yakiniku house selected for Tabelog's Yakiniku WEST Hyakumeiten in 2020 and 2021; Rurubu lists it among the Tsuruhashi shops licensed to serve raw yukhoe.
